title: banchi re-pins code-check and drops its .onnx and .npz excludes
why: Follow-up to c183 and c127 (orchestrator, Oct 28 10:05 CDT): once main's code check skips .onnx and .npz, banchi's own excludes for them are redundant.
note: Done: banchi #1001 merged Oct 31 15:28 CDT (0d08668d), by the coordinator under banchi's standing merge grant. The Oct 29 merge (banchi#995) did not carry the change: the freeze record of Oct 30 found .code-check.json still listing the .onnx and .npz excludes, so the step was requeued. Port: banchi only.
